description: Two-storey 12 x 9 m inn: red lacquered columns, open lattice front, dining hall with five tables, counter and wine shelf, straight stair, three upstairs guest rooms with beds, front balcony, blank signboard, two red lanterns, tiled gable roof and a rear kitchen annex with stove, woks and chimney.
size_note: Approx. 13.8 x 13 x 9.6 m; floor-to-floor 3.4 m; stair 17 risers of 0.2 m.
modeling_method: Claude source geometry retained; semantic materials and studio matched to SectCore04. Prior ten concept images packed; ten new renders of this revision.
